verdict.rationale: vLLM's docs directly claim "efficient multi-LoRA support for dense and MoE layers," which matches the story's core of serving multiple LoRA adapters on a base model. That claim is a single feature-list line from the overview page, with no dedicated documentation or usage detail behind it. missing for 10: dedicated LoRA serving docs (how adapters are loaded/registered and selected per request via the API), details on dynamic adapter loading or adapter limits, independent or hands-on corroboration of multi-LoRA efficiency.
